before.target: é útil me sentir bem quando você está aprendendo

after.known: I want to feel well now

problem: Meaning: generic English becomes first-person Portuguese, followed by second-person learning.
evidence: The seed and this LEGO use first-person me sentir. Here English generic feeling well when you are learning becomes my feeling well when you are learning. Replacement uses quero me sentir bem from sibling B04 and agora already present in this seed.

before.known: I was starting to feel well at the moment
before.target: estava começando a me sentir bem neste momento

after.known: I was starting to feel well this morning
after.target: estava começando a me sentir bem esta manhã

problem: R8: past event paired with present-time at the moment.
evidence: At the moment means now here, as does neste momento; neither supplies the past reference required by was starting. Replacement uses esta manhã/this morning already practised at 41:1 B08.

before.known: I wasn't thinking about it carefully at the moment
before.target: não estava pensando nisso com cuidado neste momento

after.known: I wasn't thinking about it carefully last night
after.target: não estava pensando nisso com cuidado ontem à noite

problem: R8: past progressive paired with present-time at the moment.
evidence: The seed is a past-tense statement. Sibling U04 supplies the same thought with last night, taught at 42:3; using that time expression makes the negative sentence coherent.

before.known: I want to speak Portuguese or practise speaking with other people
before.target: quero falar português ou praticar falando com outra pessoa

after.target: quero falar português ou praticar falando com outras pessoas

problem: Meaning: other people is plural, outra pessoa is singular.
evidence: Seed 41 siblings distinguish outra pessoa (someone else) from outras pessoas (other people). The English here requests the plural; replacement uses that already available plural.

before.known: I feel well or a little tired at the moment
before.target: me sinto bem ou um pouco cansado neste momento

after.known: I want to speak Portuguese this morning or this afternoon
after.target: quero falar português esta manhã ou esta tarde

problem: R8 tier 2: unsupported either/or report of the speaker’s present physical state.
evidence: I feel well or a little tired does not provide a usable standalone intention without a special uncertainty context. Siblings use ou naturally to offer alternative times; replacement recombines already practised time and speaking phrases.

before.known: if you want to practise speaking with other people
before.target: se você quiser praticar falando com outra pessoa

after.known: if you want to practise speaking with other people I want to speak with you
after.target: se você quiser praticar falando com outras pessoas quero falar com você

problem: R8: USE is only an if-clause; meaning also changes plural people to singular person.
evidence: Every word of the original belongs to the condition; no main clause completes it. Add an already practised want-to-speak clause and use the plural outras pessoas seen at 41:1.

before.target: ou se você quiser voltar amanhã ou mais tarde

after.known: if you want to come back tomorrow I want to speak with you
after.target: se você quiser voltar amanhã quero falar com você

problem: R8: USE has no main clause.
evidence: Or if you want to come back tomorrow or later remains a dependent alternative condition. Earlier siblings supply se você quiser and voltar; the completion reuses falar com você.

before.known: or if you want to practise speaking Portuguese this morning
before.target: ou se você quiser praticar falando português esta manhã

after.known: if you want to practise speaking Portuguese this morning I want to speak with you
after.target: se você quiser praticar falando português esta manhã quero falar com você

problem: R8: USE has no main clause.
evidence: The whole original is introduced by or if. Adding a main clause makes a complete conditional sentence, using the same previously practised speaking vocabulary.

before.known: if you are feeling tired this morning
before.target: se você estiver se sentindo cansado esta manhã

after.known: if you are feeling tired this morning I want to speak with you
after.target: se você estiver se sentindo cansado esta manhã quero falar com você

problem: R8: USE is a dependent if-clause.
evidence: The original ends before stating what follows from the condition. The replacement preserves its condition and adds a complete clause using existing quero falar com você.

after.target: preciso aprender mais ou falar com você

problem: R8: USE is a dependent if-clause.
evidence: If scopes over both learn more and speak with you; neither is a main clause. Removing se/if produces a complete sentence containing preciso without introducing any vocabulary.

problem: R8 and meaning: know things about is mechanically inserted before an embedded question.
evidence: The target saber directly governs se, como or há quanto tempo. English know things about adds an unsupported object and changes knowing the answer into knowing facts about the question; know plus the embedded question expresses the target intention. The target and its exact saber LEGO stay unchanged.

evidence: English asks what I am going to do; Portuguese says fazer algo agora ou mais tarde, doing something now or later. The replacement uses the existing doing-something gloss and time alternatives taught before this seed.

evidence: Portuguese queríamos ... para poder acabar naturally retains we as the understood subject, whereas English switches to I. The target also says um pouco mais de tempo, not just more time. Replacement reuses preciso de um pouco mais de tempo from 54:4 U01 and preserves para poder.

evidence: Diferente is singular and interessantes plural, so diferente e interessantes cannot describe the same noun. The replacement preserves exact singular diferente and uses quero fazer algo, taught at 51:1, with singular algo.
